title: Continuous timestep Mirror view on a shared recurrent block
hypothesis: A shared 2D recurrent transition conditioned by a continuous Givens depth coordinate, trained on depths 1-4, achieves mean depth-5..8 normalized state error <=1.1x a simple linear timestep embedding at <=90% its actual bytes with identical recurrence count.
mirror_coordinate: continuous angle omega*depth conjugating the shared transition
logical_multiplicity: depth-specific roles from one physical recurrent block
controls: four independent depth-step matrices with last-step hold beyond depth 4

task.teacher: stable transition Q(0.12*d) A Q(0.12*d)^T repeated by depth

development.selection_metric: mean normalized state error on trained depths 1-4

success_gate: On each fresh world, mean depth-5..8 normalized state error <=1.1x linear timestep embedding, bytes <=90% embedding bytes, identical recurrence count, and stable transition norms.
failure_gate: Mirror misses extrapolation quality or byte threshold, or ordinary time embedding dominates at comparable bytes.
boundaries: Teacher uses a continuously rotating transition; aligned feasibility only.
Small 2D recurrent dynamics proxy, not a Transformer reproduction.
